SMITHVILLE AREA FIRE PROTECTION DISTRICT
REGULAR MEETING
April 22, 2025
 
BOARD MEMBER PRESENT:  President Jason Ekis  
(At 7:14 p.m., the following proceedings were had:)
"MR. SCARBOROUGH:  At 7:14, Chairman Ekis called a 
meeting to order and then adjourned the meeting for lack 
of quorum." 
NEXT BOARD MEETING:  
The next regular meeting of the Board of Directors 
will be Tuesday, May 27, 2025 at 7:00 p.m.
Respectfully,
/s/ Liebe Stevenson
_______________________________
LIEBE STEVENSON, C.C.R #1340
The meeting minutes were written by Liebe Stevenson, under 
the authority of the Board of Directors. These minutes are 
not official until read, approved and signed by a member 
of the Board.
_________________________________
____________
Ryan Larson, Secretary
Date
